bd-1971-map.title: First Flag of Bangladesh (1971)

colors.note: The map of Bangladesh representing territorial integrity.

desc:
- The flag used during the Bangladesh Liberation War of 1971 was a green field with a red disc, inside which was a golden map of what was then East Pakistan
- Designed by student leader Quamrul Hasan, this version was first hoisted on 2 March 1971 at Dhaka University
- The map was later removed for simplicity, resulting in the current flag
- **Construction:** a green field (representing lush land) with a red disc offset slightly toward the hoist
- A golden map of East Pakistan sits inside the disc
- Ratio 3:5
trivia:
- During the 1971 independence war, the flag included a map of Bangladesh
- This variant symbolised the geographic identity of the emerging nation
- The map variant was used briefly during the war of independence
